patch.summary: Dynatrace cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Dynatrace pricing is plan-gated across 2 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. 15-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.
bullets: Free plan: not confirmed in SG data
Entry paid tier researched: Dynatrace Platform Subscription

blocks.title: Dynatrace plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

lines.label: Dynatrace Platform Subscription
lines.description: 15-day trial · Contact sales · Unlocks: incident management, infrastructure monitoring, APM and distributed tracing · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

lines.label: On-demand over commit
lines.description: Contact sales · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.heading: Dynatrace cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Dynatrace against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; 15-day trial documented.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (incident management, infrastructure monitoring, APM and distributed tracing) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Buying motion is an annual DPS commit — not a list price/host self-serve tile. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Enterprises that will sign a DPS commit and deploy OneAgent broadly requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Buying motion is an annual DPS commit — not a list price/host self-serve tile
Side-by-side cost with Datadog on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Buying motion is an annual DPS commit — not a list price/host self-serve tile

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Rate-card units (hosts, GiB, sessions) still dominate TCO; list price/8 GiB is not all-in

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Implementation and OneAgent coverage matter more than the trial sandbox

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Not an ITSM service desk or git host

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Not PagerDuty — Davis AI does not replace on-call paging as the primary job

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Dynatrace on identical constraints.

blocks.title: Model it-development spend with Dynatrace in mind
blocks.body: Use researched plan structure for Dynatrace alongside category cost modelling.
